mainEntity.name: What time is Assi Ghat aarti today?

acceptedAnswer.text: Morning Subah-e-Banaras runs 6:30-7:00 AM and the evening Sandhya Aarti 6:00-7:00 PM this week. Timings are updated nightly at 9:00 PM IST.

mainEntity.name: How early should I arrive for Assi Ghat aarti?

acceptedAnswer.text: Arrive 20 minutes early in winter and 40 minutes early during festivals or Dev Deepawali to secure second-step seating.

mainEntity.name: Does the aarti timing change by season?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Morning slots follow sunrise (5:15-6:30 AM across the year) and evenings follow sunset (5:45-7:30 PM). Fog, monsoon, or festivals can shift start times by ±15 minutes.

mainEntity.name: Is there an entry fee for Assi Ghat aarti?

acceptedAnswer.text: No entry fee; a voluntary donation of ₹50-₹100 supports the cultural troupe.

mainEntity.name: Can I book a taxi for Assi Ghat aarti?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Call +91-94503-01573 or WhatsApp the dispatch team for 5:45 AM and 5:00 PM pickups with wait service, blankets, and cold towels based on season.
